analogy.rationale: Penicillin-binding protein inhibitors are antibiotics targeting bacterial cell wall synthesis, and human cells lack the target, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other antibacterial/cell-wall agents, while the annotated human targets (CYP2C19, peptide transporters, OAT) are only drug-handling proteins and not responsive pathways.
